sessions.notes: Learner-requested katakana session, off the recommended plan. 6 exercises, 5 correct (83%), mean 9.2/10, trend 10-10-6-9-10-10. Strongest session so far by accuracy. Sound-to-shape transfer from hiragana was the whole story: vowel row read at 100% on first contact, scrambled order also 100%. Only miss was mnemonic interference on kiui - decoding perfect, meaning slot contaminated by the ki=key shape hook I supplied; note to self to retire shape mnemonics once a character is automatic. Katakana E/I handled correctly throughout, which is suggestive but not proof that the hiragana e/i pattern is resolved - it was not tested in hiragana this session, so that pattern stays open. Two debts growing: hiragana sa/ta/na untouched for two sessions, and 11 due reviews skipped.
